rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=60, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-6 CG-CONVERGENCE lever pushed (fd_recon_dc_n_cg 20->60), fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained breast val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: CG iters confirmed as a real bottleneck -- iter-5 (n_cg20) PSNR jumped 27.87->28.91 dB (+1.05, best lever yet), RMSE 0.0138->0.0122, wall only 144s. Still ~7.4 dB below the 128-view sparse-FBP floor (PSNR36.32/RMSE0.0052), hr=0. (2) Failure mode: the hard CG DC-solve is under-converged; each extra CG batch overwrites more of the mis-scaled Mayo-prior warm-start with the true LS solution. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_dc_n_cg 20->60 (3x more), else = iter-5. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if PSNR keeps climbing toward the FBP floor, the recon is DC-LIMITED and the prior is merely an overwritten warm-start; this maps how close pure data-consistency gets on sparse breast and whether hr can clear 0. If PSNR plateaus well below 36 dB, the 8 discrete DC injections (one per Euler step, each re-embedding the mis-scaled prior) cap the achievable RMSE -> confirm the WDM-Mayo prior is below-baseline on sparse breast. (5) BUDGET: 144s at n_cg20; 3x CG ~7-8 min, well inside 20-min. (6) Loop continues; iter-7 on landing.
